ai_task_runs_deadline.name: ai_task_runs_deadline
ai_task_runs_deadline.value:
("ai_task_runs"."deadline_ms" is null or "ai_task_runs"."deadline_ms" > 0)
        and ("ai_task_runs"."deadline_outcome" is null or "ai_task_runs"."deadline_outcome" in ('met','aborted','none'))

ai_task_runs_waits.name: ai_task_runs_waits
ai_task_runs_waits.value:
("ai_task_runs"."retry_wait_ms" is null or "ai_task_runs"."retry_wait_ms" >= 0)
        and ("ai_task_runs"."requeue_ms" is null or "ai_task_runs"."requeue_ms" >= 0)

atomic_note_relations_values.name: atomic_note_relations_values
atomic_note_relations_values.value:
"atomic_note_relations"."direction" in ('lo_to_hi','hi_to_lo','symmetric','unknown')
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."band" is null or "atomic_note_relations"."band" in ('apply','suggest'))
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."probability" is null or "atomic_note_relations"."probability" between 0 and 1)
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."veto_source" is null or "atomic_note_relations"."veto_source" in ('explainer','typer'))
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."veto_source" is null) = ("atomic_note_relations"."vetoed_at" is null)
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" is null or "atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" in ('supports','contradicts','extends','depends_on','example_of','clarifies','same_as','contrasts','similar_to','mentions','related'))

atomic_note_relations_v2.name: atomic_note_relations_v2
atomic_note_relations_v2.value:
("atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" is not null or "atomic_note_relations"."band" is not null)
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."direction" <> 'unknown' or "atomic_note_relations"."band" is null)
        and ("atomic_note_relations"."band" is null or (
          ("atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" is null or "atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" in ('supports','contradicts','extends','depends_on','example_of','clarifies','same_as'))
          and case when "atomic_note_relations"."relation_type" in ('supports','extends','depends_on','example_of','clarifies')
                then "atomic_note_relations"."direction" in ('lo_to_hi','hi_to_lo')
                else "atomic_note_relations"."direction" = 'symmetric' end))

jobs_dedupe_key.name: jobs_dedupe_key
jobs_dedupe_key.value: "jobs"."dedupe_key" is null or char_length("jobs"."dedupe_key") between 1 and 200

note_match_state_values.name: note_match_state_values
note_match_state_values.value:
char_length("note_match_state"."decider_key") between 1 and 200 and char_length("note_match_state"."space_key") between 1 and 200
        and ("note_match_state"."kth_cosine" is null or "note_match_state"."kth_cosine" between -1 and 1)

prompt_revisions_scope_check.name: prompt_revisions_scope_check
prompt_revisions_scope_check.value: "prompt_revisions"."scope" in ('global','function','domain','domain_function') and (("prompt_revisions"."scope" in ('domain','domain_function')) = ("prompt_revisions"."domain_id" is not null))

relation_decisions_directions.name: relation_decisions_directions
relation_decisions_directions.value:
("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" is not null or "relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" is not null)
        and case when "relation_decisions"."score_scale" = 'log_odds' then
              "relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_relation_type" is null and "relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_relation_type" is null
              and ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" is null or ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" > '-Infinity'::float8 and "relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" < 'Infinity'::float8))
              and ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" is null or ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" > '-Infinity'::float8 and "relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" < 'Infinity'::float8))
            else
              ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" is null) = ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_relation_type" is null)
              and ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" is null) = ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_relation_type" is null)
              and coalesce("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score", 0) between 0 and 1
              and coalesce("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score", 0) between 0 and 1
            end

relation_decisions_decided_at.name: relation_decisions_decided_at
relation_decisions_decided_at.value:
("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" is null) = ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_decided_at" is null)
        and ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" is null) = ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_decided_at" is null)
        and ("relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_score" is not null or "relation_decisions"."lo_to_hi_ai_task_run_id" is null)
        and ("relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_score" is not null or "relation_decisions"."hi_to_lo_ai_task_run_id" is null)

relation_events_values.name: relation_events_values
relation_events_values.value:
"relation_events"."relation_kind" in ('note','source')
        and "relation_events"."kind" in ('applied','suggested','typed','untyped','vetoed','kept','removed','promoted','retired','reconciled')
        and char_length("relation_events"."pair_key") between 1 and 200

relation_match_runs_values.name: relation_match_runs_values
relation_match_runs_values.value:
"relation_match_runs"."kind" in ('match','link','type','promote','discover','review','veto','reconcile','retype')
        and ("relation_match_runs"."outcome" is null or char_length("relation_match_runs"."outcome") between 1 and 200)
        and jsonb_typeof("relation_match_runs"."counts") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("relation_match_runs"."timings") = 'object'

relation_typings_verdict.name: relation_typings_verdict
relation_typings_verdict.value:
"relation_typings"."relation_type" in ('supports','contradicts','extends','depends_on','example_of','clarifies','same_as','none')
        and case when "relation_typings"."relation_type" = 'none' then "relation_typings"."direction" is null
                 when "relation_typings"."relation_type" in ('supports','extends','depends_on','example_of','clarifies')
                   then "relation_typings"."direction" in ('lo_to_hi','hi_to_lo')
                 else "relation_typings"."direction" = 'symmetric' end
        and char_length("relation_typings"."pair_key") between 1 and 200 and char_length("relation_typings"."typer_key") between 1 and 200
        and char_length("relation_typings"."lo_hash") between 1 and 200 and char_length("relation_typings"."hi_hash") between 1 and 200

source_match_state_values.name: source_match_state_values
source_match_state_values.value:
("source_match_state"."nearest_root_id" is null or "source_match_state"."nearest_root_id" <> "source_match_state"."root_id")
        and ("source_match_state"."nearest_cosine" is null or "source_match_state"."nearest_cosine" between -1 and 1)
        and char_length("source_match_state"."space_key") between 1 and 200 and char_length("source_match_state"."fingerprint") between 1 and 200

source_relations_scores.name: source_relations_scores
source_relations_scores.value:
("source_relations"."importance" is null or "source_relations"."importance" between 0 and 1)
        and ("source_relations"."confidence" is null or "source_relations"."confidence" between 0 and 1)

source_relations_origin.name: source_relations_origin
source_relations_origin.value:
"source_relations"."origin" in ('judged','promoted')
        and ("source_relations"."origin" <> 'judged' or ("source_relations"."importance" is not null and "source_relations"."confidence" is not null))
        and ("source_relations"."origin" <> 'promoted' or ("source_relations"."support_count" is not null and "source_relations"."support_count" >= 1))
        and ("source_relations"."support_count" is null or "source_relations"."support_count" >= 1)

topic_change_sets_status.name: topic_change_sets_status
topic_change_sets_status.value:
"topic_change_sets"."status" in ('applied','undone','pending_review','dismissed')
        and ("topic_change_sets"."status" in ('applied','undone')) = ("topic_change_sets"."generation" is not null)
        and ("topic_change_sets"."status" in ('applied','undone')) = ("topic_change_sets"."applied_at" is not null)
        and ("topic_change_sets"."status" = 'undone') = ("topic_change_sets"."undone_at" is not null)

topic_overview_citations_citation.name: topic_overview_citations_citation
topic_overview_citations_citation.value:
"topic_overview_citations"."n" between 1 and 40 and char_length("topic_overview_citations"."excerpt") between 1 and 1200
        and char_length("topic_overview_citations"."excerpt_hash") between 1 and 200

topic_overviews_shape.name: topic_overviews_shape
topic_overviews_shape.value:
jsonb_typeof("topic_overviews"."paragraphs") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("topic_overviews"."paragraphs") between 1 and 12
        and jsonb_typeof("topic_overviews"."evidence") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("topic_overviews"."evidence") <= 40
        and jsonb_typeof("topic_overviews"."support") = 'object' and "topic_overviews"."member_count" >= 0

topic_overviews_text.name: topic_overviews_text
topic_overviews_text.value:
char_length("topic_overviews"."member_fingerprint") between 1 and 200 and char_length("topic_overviews"."input_hash") between 1 and 200
        and char_length("topic_overviews"."prompt_revision_id") between 1 and 200 and char_length("topic_overviews"."language") >= 1

topic_placements_item.name: topic_placements_item
topic_placements_item.value:
("topic_placements"."item_kind" = 'note' and "topic_placements"."note_id" is not null and "topic_placements"."source_item_id" is null)
        or ("topic_placements"."item_kind" = 'source' and "topic_placements"."source_item_id" is not null and "topic_placements"."note_id" is null
            and "topic_placements"."root_source_item_id" is null)

topic_placements_decision.name: topic_placements_decision
topic_placements_decision.value:
"topic_placements"."management" in ('ai','human')
        and "topic_placements"."decided_by" in ('build','auto','gate','fallback','fallback-none','human','rebuild')
        and ("topic_placements"."item_fingerprint" is null or char_length("topic_placements"."item_fingerprint") between 1 and 200)

topic_structure_events_item.name: topic_structure_events_item
topic_structure_events_item.value:
("topic_structure_events"."item_kind" is null) = ("topic_structure_events"."item_id" is null)
        and ("topic_structure_events"."item_kind" is null or "topic_structure_events"."item_kind" in ('note','source'))

topic_trees_life.name: topic_trees_life
topic_trees_life.value:
("topic_trees"."status" = 'retired') = ("topic_trees"."retired_at" is not null)
        and ("topic_trees"."status" <> 'active' or "topic_trees"."activated_at" is not null)

topic_trees_text.name: topic_trees_text
topic_trees_text.value: char_length("topic_trees"."space_key") between 1 and 300 and char_length("topic_trees"."config_hash") between 1 and 200

topics_sibling_title_uidx.name: topics_sibling_title_uidx
topics_sibling_title_uidx.where: "topics"."retired_at" is null and "topics"."title" is not null

topics_parent.name: topics_parent
topics_parent.value: "topics"."parent_id" is distinct from "topics"."id" and ("topics"."role" = 'root') = ("topics"."parent_id" is null)

topics_name_state.name: topics_name_state
topics_name_state.value:
"topics"."name_state" in ('named','provisional','unnamed')
        and ("topics"."name_source" is null or "topics"."name_source" in ('llm','human','tfidf'))
        and ("topics"."role" = 'root' or ("topics"."name_state" = 'unnamed') = ("topics"."title" is null))

topics_text.name: topics_text
topics_text.value:
("topics"."title" is null or char_length("topics"."title") between 1 and 120)
        and ("topics"."description" is null or char_length("topics"."description") between 1 and 400)
        and ("topics"."name_language" is null or char_length("topics"."name_language") >= 1)
        and jsonb_typeof("topics"."aliases") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("topics"."aliases") <= 10

topics_redirect.name: topics_redirect
topics_redirect.value: ("topics"."redirect_to" is null or "topics"."retired_at" is not null) and "topics"."redirect_to" is distinct from "topics"."id"
